memory_update.text: AMKR should be retained as the obvious US-listed advanced-packaging/OSAT reference anchor for HBM-to-logic integration, but not treated as the main underfollowed alpha lane.
FORM is a high-priority underfollowed lane for HBM and advanced-package test intensity through probe cards and known-good-die/known-good-stack test requirements.
